verdict.rationale: Formant is a cloud fleet-operations, observability and teleoperation platform with an on-device data and command agent. It is not robot middleware or a driver framework. Stable hardware-abstraction interfaces for swapping sensors and actuators belong to the robot runtime (e.g. ROS drivers), so this story is a category error for Formant. Its multi-vendor data normalization and adapter restarting are fleet-level features and do not make this axis apply.
